curvatureScale.description: Strength of the G and B masks (default 1): a fold of a quarter turn (90 degrees) is a full edge or cavity at 1; use 2 to make a 45 degree fold full, 0 to switch both masks off.

deform.description:
Which deform mesh variant to run.
bend: Bend a dynamic mesh along axis (X, Y or Z, default Z) by strength degrees (default 45), the bend spread over its length along that axis and centred on its local origin, the pivot. The reply gives the angle.
twist: Twist a dynamic mesh about axis (X, Y or Z, default Z) by strength degrees (default 45) across its length along that axis, centred on its local origin. The reply gives the angle.
taper: Flare a dynamic mesh around axis (X, Y or Z, default Z): its cross-section grows by strength percent (default 50) at the middle of its length and not at all at the ends, so a positive strength bulges it and a negative one pinches it (a sine profile, not a straight taper).
stretch: Scale a dynamic mesh along one axis (X, Y or Z, default Z) by strength (default 1.5: 2 doubles it, 0.5 halves it) about its local origin, the other axes unchanged.
spherify: Pull every vertex of a dynamic mesh toward a sphere around its bounds centre, as large as its largest half-extent: strength 0 to 1 (default 1, clamped) is how far, 1 making it that sphere.
cylindrify: Pull every vertex of a dynamic mesh toward a cylinder around axis (X, Y or Z, default Z) through its bounds centre, its radius the average distance of the vertices from that axis: strength 0 to 1 (default 1, clamped) is how far. The reply gives avgRadius and verticesModified.
smooth: Smooth a dynamic mesh: iterations (default 10) of Laplacian smoothing, each moving every vertex strength (default 0.2) of the way toward its neighbours; the mesh shrinks a little. Fewer than 1 iteration or a strength of 0 is refused.
relax: Relax a dynamic mesh: the same smoothing as smooth with other defaults (3 iterations, strength 0.5), to even out vertex spacing. Fewer than 1 iteration or a strength of 0 is refused.
noise_deform: Displace a dynamic mesh along its normals by Perlin noise: strength is the height in cm (default 5) and frequency the noise cycles per cm (default three bumps across its largest dimension). The reply gives both.
lattice_deform: Ripple a dynamic mesh with a sine wave: every vertex moves along axis (X, Y or Z, default Z) by a wave latticeResolution cycles across its bounds (2 to 16, default 3), at most weight (-2 to 2, default 0.25) times a quarter of its largest size, fading to nothing three quarters of that size from position (default the bounds centre). A procedural ripple, not a cage of control points.
displace_by_texture: Raise a dynamic mesh by a heightmap texture projected straight down over its X/Y bounds: each vertex moves along axis (X, Y or Z, default Z) by (luminance - midpoint) x heightScale (midpoint 0 to 1, default 0.5; heightScale cm, default 10). A texture that does not load is TEXTURE_NOT_FOUND, one whose source format cannot be read TEXTURE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED.

depth.description: Primitive depth: a box's size along Z; a plane's size along Y (a plane lies flat in XY, centred, facing +Z).

dropRepeats.description: Leave out an object that only repeats a larger one where it stands, such as an LOD copy an importer merged into the mesh (default true).

dryRun.description: Answer the meshes the split would make (size, triangles, offset, and exists when the name is taken) and create nothing, to tune gap and minTriangles first. A large pack can take longer than one call waits.

edgeMaterials.description: Material id of each edge of the section loop, one per edge (point k to point k+1; a closed loop has as many edges as points, an open one one fewer): the strip each edge sweeps keeps it, for a painted band, a stripe or a row of windows. Default 0.

edges.description: Edge ids to split at their midpoints.

edit.description:
Which edit dynamic mesh variant to run.
create: Spawn a DynamicMesh actor to author geometry into: empty, or a copy of a static mesh asset.
append_vertex: Append one vertex to a DynamicMesh actor and return its index.
append_triangle: Append a triangle to a DynamicMesh actor from three corner positions.
append_polygons: Author a polygon cage on a DynamicMesh actor in one call: new vertices and faces of three or more corners, each with its own polygroup and material id.
append_cuboids: Append axis-aligned boxes to a DynamicMesh actor in one call, each with a material id, faces left open and a repeat along up to three axes (a railing, a stack of crates, a grid of windows, shelves, pillars), wound outward for you.
append_loft: Append a surface lofted through cross sections to a DynamicMesh actor: each section a loop of points (the same count in every one), joined in order with every face turned outward, the ends capped flat or closed to a tip point.
append_mesh: Copy a static mesh asset into a DynamicMesh actor at placements, each repeated along up to three axes, with its material slots mapped to the target's material ids (a list cycles copy by copy for colour variety): a model assembled from detailed parts in one call, its copies keeping the asset's normals and UVs.
delete_triangles: Delete the triangles of a DynamicMesh actor that triangleIndices or a region picks (by box, facing direction, polygroup or material id), with the points only they used.
set_vertex_position: Move one vertex of a DynamicMesh actor to a new position.
set_vertex_color: Set the vertex colour on one vertex, or on every vertex, of a DynamicMesh actor.
bake_vertex_colors: Bake ambient occlusion, convex-edge, concave-cavity and height masks into the vertex colours of a DynamicMesh actor, for a material to read through its VertexColor node.
set_material_id: Set the material id (the static-mesh material slot) of triangles of a DynamicMesh actor: every triangle, the triangleIndices you list, or a region.
set_uvs: Set the UV coordinate of one vertex on a UV channel of a DynamicMesh actor.
split_normals: Split the normals of a DynamicMesh actor above an angle threshold to harden edges.
translate: Translate every vertex of a DynamicMesh actor, leaving the actor transform alone.
difference: Subtract a tool mesh from a target mesh under the difference spelling of boolean_subtract.

enableCollision.description: Enable simple collision on the created DynamicMesh actor.

endPoint.description: Close the last section as a fan of triangles to this point instead of a flat cap: a bow, a nose cone, a spire. Needs closed true.

faceGroups.description: Polygroup id of each face, one entry per face, 0 to 1000000 (default: a new unique group per face). Subdivision with catmull_clark treats every polygroup as one face of the cage, so leave this out for a cage of separate faces; give several faces one id to make one flat region.

faceMaterials.description: Material id of each face, one entry per face, 0 to 255 (default 0). A material id becomes a static-mesh material slot when the mesh is baked with convert_to_static_mesh or convert_to_nanite.

faces.description: Faces, each a list of three or more vertex indices into vertices (at most 20000 faces). List a face's corners so that (v1 - v0) x (v2 - v0) points outward, and let two faces that share an edge run along it in opposite directions; the call refuses a face wound the other way, or an edge shared by more than two faces, and names the face. A face with more than three corners is triangulated (it may be concave) and all its triangles keep the face's polygroup. The new faces get smooth normals, shared where they meet; split_normals creases the hard edges.

flip.description: Reverse every face. A closed tube is turned outward from the first section's turning order and the way the sections run, so flip is for an open sheet or an inside surface (a tunnel seen from within).

floating.description: Build the stairs as free-floating steps with no solid underside.

frequency.description: Noise frequency in cycles per unit; defaults to three bumps across the mesh's largest dimension.

gap.description: With by parts: pieces whose bounds come within this many cm of each other are one object (default 2).

groupID.description: Polygroup id assigned to the appended triangle.

height.description: Box Y dimension: the box is X=width, Y=height, Z=depth (dimensions.{x,y,z}).

heightSegments.description: Tessellation segments along height (on a plane, along its depth, Y).

hullCount.description: Number of convex hulls for decomposition.

innerRadius.description: In cm, per variant. Disc and ring: the centred hole (disc default 0, solid; ring 25). Pipe: the inner wall (default 40). Torus and arch: the TUBE radius, its round cross-section, not a hole (default 20 torus, 25 arch); the opening under an arch is radius - innerRadius. Spiral stairs: the radius of the central well.

keepTool.description: Keep the tool actor after the operation.

latticeResolution.description: Control lattice resolution for lattice deformation.

length.description: Length along the primary axis: the capsule shaft, or the ramp run.

lod.description: Which geometry is copied: source (default) is the full-detail source mesh; render is the mesh as it draws, for a Nanite mesh its fallback, often a twentieth of the source triangles: use it to lay out many copies of a Nanite part within the mesh's 500000-triangle budget.

lodCount.description: Number of LOD levels to generate.

lodOp.description:
Which configure mesh lods variant to run.
generate: Generate LODs for a dynamic mesh.
set_settings: Set the reduction of one LOD of the static mesh asset an actor draws.
set_screen_sizes: Set the screen sizes at which the LODs of the static mesh asset an actor draws take over.

materialId.description: Material id to set, 0 to 255. The baked asset gets the highest id used + 1 slots.

materials.description: Materials for the baked asset's slots as asset paths (a material or material instance): entry i is the material of slot i, which holds every triangle with material id i (set ids with edit_dynamic_mesh set_material_id). The asset gets the mesh's highest material id + 1 slots; slots you do not list, or list as "", keep the default material. A path that is unsafe or does not load as a material is refused before anything is created, and so is a list longer than the slot count.

maxHullCount.description: Hull budget (1 to 64, default 8) when collisionType is convex_decomposition.

maxParts.description: More parts than this (default 64) refuses the split with nothing made.

meshPath.description: Static mesh asset to start from: its geometry is copied in, each section as the material id of its slot, in the mesh's own local space. Omitted, the mesh starts empty.

minTriangles.description: Objects with fewer triangles are left out (default 12): loose bits, decal cards.

modeling.description:
Which model mesh variant to run.
extrude: Extrude selected faces of a dynamic mesh.
inset: Inset selected faces of a dynamic mesh.
outset: Outset selected faces of a dynamic mesh.
offset_faces: Offset selected faces of a dynamic mesh.
bevel: Bevel selected edges of a dynamic mesh.
chamfer: Chamfer selected edges of a dynamic mesh.
bridge: Bridge two edge loops of a dynamic mesh.
loft: Loft between two or more profile curves.
sweep: Sweep a profile along a path of a dynamic mesh.
revolve: Turn a profile of {radius, height} points around the vertical axis into a new dynamic mesh actor: a vase, column, bottle, tower or dome.
shell: Create a shell (inner offset) of a dynamic mesh.
loop_cut: Insert evenly spaced edge loops across a dynamic mesh, perpendicular to an axis.
edge_split: Split edges of a dynamic mesh at their midpoints.
poke: Poke faces of a dynamic mesh: add a centre vertex to each triangle (optionally pushed out along its normal) and fan it into three triangles.
quadrangulate: Group pairs of adjacent triangles of a dynamic mesh into quad PolyGroups, so PolyGroup edits (extrude, inset, bevel by group) act on quads. The mesh itself stays triangles.
extrude_along_spline: Extrude a profile along a spline actor.
duplicate_along_spline: Duplicate a mesh along a spline actor.

name.description: Name for the new asset or node.

namePrefix.description: Names are <namePrefix>01, <namePrefix>02 ..., largest part first (default <source name>_Part); a name already taken refuses the split before anything is made.

numRings.description: Number of rings for sphere, capsule, torus, arch.

numSides.description: Number of sides for cylinder, cone, disc, ring, torus.

numSteps.description: Number of steps for stair primitives.

numTurns.description: Number of turns for spiral stairs (converted to a curve angle).

oneOf.description: Offset vector.
Row: the step from one copy to the next in the mesh's local space, cm (default 100 along x); copy k sits k steps from the original.

operation.description: dilate grows the surface outward by distance, contract shrinks it inward; close (the default) fills creases and rounds the seams where parts meet, a fillet up to about twice distance wide; open shaves off bumps and thin parts smaller than distance.

optimization.description:
Which optimize mesh variant to run.
simplify_mesh: Simplify a dynamic mesh to a target triangle count.
remesh_uniform: Uniformly remesh a dynamic mesh to a target edge length.
remesh_voxel: Voxel-wrap a dynamic mesh into one watertight, smooth-shaded surface (the engine's solidify): the mesh is sampled into a grid and rebuilt, closing holes and merging overlapping parts.
subdivide: Subdivide a dynamic mesh: pn tessellation (default), or a Catmull-Clark, Loop or bilinear subdivision surface.
morphology: Offset a dynamic mesh's surface through a voxel grid: dilate, contract, close (fillet the seams where unioned parts meet) or open.
merge_vertices: Merge coincident vertices of a dynamic mesh.
weld_vertices: Weld vertices of a dynamic mesh within a distance.
remove_degenerates: Remove degenerate triangles from a dynamic mesh.
fill_holes: Fill boundary holes of a dynamic mesh.
flip_normals: Flip normals of a dynamic mesh.
recalculate_normals: Recalculate normals of a dynamic mesh.
recompute_tangents: Recompute tangents of a dynamic mesh.

outerRadius.description: Outer radius for ring and pipe primitives.

pivot.description: Each new mesh's pivot: bottom (default), the bottom centre of its bounds, so it stands on what it is placed on; center; or source, the source's own origin.

location.description: Where the copy's pivot goes, in the target mesh's local space (default 0, 0, 0).

rotation.description: Turn of the copy in degrees (default none).

scale.description: Scale of the copy on each axis (default 1, 1, 1); a negative axis mirrors it, faces still turned outward.

materialIds.description: The target material id of each material slot of the copied mesh, one entry per slot in slot order (the reply's sourceSlots, or inspect_object objectKind=mesh, says how many): an id, or a list of ids the copies take in turn (copy k takes entry k modulo the list length) for colour variety across a stack or a row. Omitted, each slot keeps its own index as its id.

count.description: Copies along offset, the copy itself included (default 1).

offset.description: Step from one copy to the next, e.g. {x: 200} for one every 2 m.

rowOffset.description: Step from one row to the next.

layers.description: Layers of those rows (default 1), e.g. the tiers of a stack.

layerOffset.description: Step from one layer to the next.

repeat.description: Lay the copy out count x rows x layers times, each copy moved by offset per step, rowOffset per row and layerOffset per layer. A step larger than the copy leaves a gap between copies.

placements.description: Where the copies go, at most 2500 once repeats are unrolled: each placement a transform in the target mesh's local space, an optional repeat on up to three axes (its steps add to location and are not turned by rotation), and how the copy's material slots map to the target's material ids.

position.description: Position {x, y, z} for the operation.

primitive.description:
Which create primitive variant to run.
box: Create a box dynamic mesh actor.
sphere: Create a sphere dynamic mesh actor.
cylinder: Create a cylinder dynamic mesh actor.
cone: Create a cone dynamic mesh actor.
capsule: Create a capsule dynamic mesh actor.
plane: Create a plane dynamic mesh actor: flat in XY, centred on its origin, facing +Z.
disc: Create a disc dynamic mesh actor.
ring: Create a ring dynamic mesh actor.
torus: Create a torus dynamic mesh actor.
pipe: Create a pipe dynamic mesh actor.
arch: Create an arch dynamic mesh actor.
ramp: Create a ramp dynamic mesh actor.
stairs: Create a stairs dynamic mesh actor.
spiral_stairs: Create a spiral stairs dynamic mesh actor.
sdf: Create one smooth organic mesh actor from blended shapes (a signed distance field): spheres, ellipsoids, rounded boxes, capsules, cylinders, tori and cones joined with soft fillets, carved with rounded recesses, or intersected, each shape with its own material slot.

radius.description: Distance from the axis in cm, 0 or more.

height.description: Height above the base in cm.

profile.description: Points from bottom to top, at least 2. For a hollow shape with walls, go up the outside and back down the inside. A closed loop (end on the first point) with cap false turns a solid ring section, such as a moulding or a tyre. Omit for a small built-in vase.

radialSegments.description: Radial tessellation segments for circular primitives.

radius.description: Radius in cm (default 50). Torus and arch: from the centre to the middle of the tube (arch default 100). Pipe: the outer wall, as outerRadius. Spiral stairs: the inner radius when innerRadius is not given (default 150).

region.description: Pick the triangles to work on by where they are or what they carry, instead of by id; give this or triangleIndices, not both. Every filter given must hold, so they AND together. Boxes and directions are in the mesh's local space, not world space. A region that matches nothing is refused (REGION_EMPTY) with the mesh's local bounds in the message, and the reply's trianglesSelected says how many triangles were picked.

box.description: Triangles whose centroid lies inside this box (inclusive), in the mesh's local space.

min.description: Corner with the smallest x, y and z.

max.description: Corner with the largest x, y and z.

normal.description: Direction {x, y, z} in the mesh's local space; picks the triangles that face it, within normalAngle. {x: 0, y: 0, z: 1} is the top faces.

normalAngle.description: Degrees either side of normal that still count as facing it (default 30).

groupIds.description: Triangles that belong to one of these polygroup ids; a mesh without polygroups is all group 0.

materialIds.description: Triangles that carry one of these material ids (a mesh without material ids is all 0).

resolution.description: Grid cells along the longest side of the shapes' bounds (default 128, 16-256): higher is finer and slower; 160-200 suits a hero part.

respectHardNormals.description: Never pair two triangles across a hard edge (default false).

respectUVSeams.description: Never pair two triangles across a UV seam (default true).

oneOf.description: UV rotation in degrees (transform_uvs takes a scalar, not a rotator).
Rotation {pitch, yaw, roll}.

scheme.description: Subdivision scheme (default pn). pn: PN tessellation, which adds triangles and keeps the shape. catmull_clark: a smooth subdivision surface over a polygon cage, where every polygroup is one face (build the cage with edit_dynamic_mesh append_polygons, or start from create_box, which has one polygroup per face); the surface rounds toward the cage, and polygroups and material ids carry through. loop: smooths the triangles as they are and needs no cage. bilinear: cuts the cage into quads without smoothing. iterations is the level.

sections.description: Cross sections in order along the shape, 2 to 256, each a list of {x, y, z} points in the mesh's local space, the same count in every section (3 or more for a closed loop). Point k of one section joins point k of the next, so list every section in the same turning order from the same starting place. A section need not be flat (a raked bow); a section a few cm across gives a blunt end, endPoint a sharp one.

segments.description: Subdivisions for a rounded bevel (UE 5.4 or later); omit or 0 for a flat bevel.

setAll.description: Apply the colour to every vertex instead of one.

shapes.description: Shapes combined in order onto shapes[0] (which must be a union) as one signed distance field, then meshed. Sizes are cm in the mesh's local space. Each joined shape takes a blend: the radius of the soft fillet where it meets what came before. An entry with mirror or repeat stands for all its copies (at most 1024 shapes in all), applied in its place in the order.

type.description: sphere (radius), ellipsoid (radii), box (extent = half size, rounding), capsule (radius, length of the straight part, along local Z), cylinder (radius, length, rounding, along local Z), torus (radius to the tube centre, thickness = tube radius, in local XY), cone (radius at the bottom, topRadius, length, along local Z, rounded ends). radius also sets an ellipsoid's radii and a box's extent when those are left out; any other size a type does not read is refused.

operation.description: union adds the shape (default), subtract carves it out of what came before (a recess, socket or groove), intersect keeps only the overlap.

center.description: Shape centre in the mesh's local space, cm (default 0,0,0); with relativeTo, in that shape's frame.

relativeTo.description: Index of an earlier shapes[] entry to place this one on: center, rotation, repeat and mirror are then measured from that shape's centre along its own turned axes (not scaled by its size), so the eyes, mouth or buttons of a leaning or turned part stay on it without working out the rotation. mirror then reflects across that shape's own planes.

rotation.description: Shape rotation {pitch, yaw, roll} in degrees; turns the shape's local Z axis for capsule, cylinder, cone and torus.

radius.description: Radius in cm (sphere, capsule, cylinder, cone base; torus: distance to the tube centre). Default 50.

radii.description: Ellipsoid radii along local X, Y, Z in cm.

extent.description: Box half size along local X, Y, Z in cm.

rounding.description: Box or cylinder edge rounding radius in cm (0 = sharp).

length.description: Capsule straight length, cylinder or cone height, in cm (default 100).

topRadius.description: Cone radius at the top in cm (0 = point; larger than radius widens upward).

blend.description: Smooth-join radius in cm with the shapes before it: 0 is a hard edge; a few cm reads as a soft fillet on a union and as a rounded rim on a subtract.

materialId.description: Material slot of the surface this shape forms (default 0). A subtract shape owns the surface it carves, so a carved visor can take its own slot.

mirror.description: Also add this shape reflected across the mesh's own plane through the origin normal to each listed axis ("y" mirrors y to -y): both eyes, both ears or a pair of legs from one entry. Each axis doubles the copies so far, so ["x","y"] gives four; repeat copies are mirrored too.

repeat.description: Copies of this shape with the same size, blend, operation and materialId: a row with offset, or a ring with axis. A row of stitches, rivets round a rim or curls round a head is one entry. The reply's parts[] still lists one entry per shapes[] item, with copies.

count.description: How many, the shape itself included.

offset.description: Row: each copy moves this much further from the previous one, cm.

axis.description: Ring: turn the copies about this mesh axis through pivot (each copy turns with it).

angle.description: Ring: total sweep in degrees (default 360, evenly spaced all round; a smaller arc puts the last copy at its end).

pivot.description: Ring: a point on the turning axis, cm (default 0,0,0).

splineActorName.description: Spline actor name for extrude/sweep along spline.

splitAngle.description: Angle threshold in degrees above which normals are split.

startPoint.description: Close the first section as a fan of triangles to this point instead of a flat cap: a bow, a nose cone, a spire. Needs closed true.

steps.description: Number of steps (default 8; numSteps wins when both are sent).

strength.description: Deformation strength: bend/twist angle in degrees, taper flare percent, noise displacement in units, stretch factor, spherify/cylindrify blend 0-1.

targetActor.description: The dynamic mesh actor to edit, by label or name (actorName is the same and wins when both are sent).

targetHullCount.description: Target hull count for collision simplification.

tileSize.description: World size in cm one texture repeat covers (100 repeats a brick texture every metre); omitted, the texture spans each side of the mesh once.

toolActor.description: Tool actor name for boolean operations.

topRadius.description: Cone top radius; non-zero makes a truncated cone. Defaults to 0.

translation.description: Translation {x, y, z} applied to every mesh vertex.

triangleIndices.description: Triangle ids the operation is limited to; omit to apply it to the whole mesh. Give this or region, not both.

trianglePercent.description: Percent of triangles to keep for LOD reduction.

trimActorName.description: Trim actor name for boolean trim.

uvOp.description:
Which edit uvs variant to run.
auto: Unwrap a dynamic mesh actor with XAtlas into uvChannel (default 0, made when missing): seams are cut and the islands packed into the 0-1 square, compacting the mesh first (compacted). When XAtlas writes nothing it falls back to a bounds-sized box projection (method box_projection_fallback, with xatlasError saying why). The reply gives uvElementCount; none at all is UV_GENERATION_FAILED.
unwrap: Same as uvOp=auto: unwrap a dynamic mesh actor with XAtlas into uvChannel, falling back to a bounds-sized box projection, and report uvElementCount.
project: Box-project UVs onto a dynamic mesh actor into uvChannel (default 0, made when missing): each triangle takes the face of the box it points at. tileSize is the world size one texture repeat covers, for tiling materials such as brick or concrete; without it the box is the mesh bounds and the texture spans each side once. The reply gives projectionSize.
pack_islands: Repack the UV islands already in uvChannel (default 0) of a dynamic mesh actor into the 0-1 square without overlap, keeping each island's shape.
transform: Move, scale and turn the UVs already in uvChannel (default 0) of a dynamic mesh actor, in that order: uvOffset {u, v} shifts them, uvScale {u, v} scales them about the middle of the 0-1 square (2 repeats a texture twice), rotation turns them by degrees about the same point. The reply echoes what was applied.

v0.description: First corner {x, y, z} of the appended triangle. The triangle faces the side (v1 - v0) x (v2 - v0) points to, as append_polygons faces do; the other side is culled.

v1.description: Second corner {x, y, z} of the appended triangle.

v2.description: Third corner {x, y, z} of the appended triangle.

vertexIndex.description: Index of the vertex the operation targets.

vertices.description: New points {x, y, z} in the mesh's local space, at most 20000. The faces of this call index into this list, so its first point is index 0. Points are never merged with the mesh's existing ones, and a point no face uses is left out.

voxelCount.description: Grid cells along the mesh's longest side for the voxel operations (default 128, clamped to 16-256): more cells keep thinner detail and cost more time and triangles. The reply's voxelSize is the resulting cell width in cm.

tools.name: manage_interaction
tools.description: Create interactive objects: doors, switches, chests, levers. Set up destructible meshes and trigger volumes.

actorName.description: Target actor name in the current level.

autoClose.description: Whether it closes by itself after the last pawn leaves (default false: it stays open).

autoCloseDelay.description: Seconds after the last pawn leaves before an autoClose door or lid shuts (default 3).

canToggle.description: Whether the switch can toggle back off.

chestPath.description: Canonical /Game chest actor Blueprint asset path.

componentName.description: Name for the component added to the Blueprint.

doorPath.description: Canonical /Game door actor Blueprint asset path.

folder.description: Canonical /Game folder that receives the created asset.

kind.description:
Which create interactable variant to run.
door: Create a door actor Blueprint asset that opens when a pawn comes near.
chest: Create a chest actor Blueprint asset whose lid opens when a pawn comes near.
switch: Create a switch actor Blueprint (name in folder, default /Game/Interactables): a mesh and an overlap sphere that a pawn walking in switches, firing OnSwitchChanged(bActivated). switchType button (the default) or lever flips per press, pressure_plate holds while stood on; another type is refused.
lever: Create a lever actor Blueprint asset.
trigger: Create a trigger actor Blueprint asset.
interface: Create an interactable Blueprint interface asset.
component: Add an interaction component to a Blueprint asset.

name.description: Name for the created asset or actor.

openAngle.description: Open angle in degrees (a new door gets 90, a new chest lid 100).

openTime.description: Seconds the door or lid takes to swing fully open or shut (a new door gets 0.5, a new chest 0.6).

setting.description:
Which configure interactable variant to run.
door: Configure persistent door properties, or make the door follow a switch.
chest: Configure persistent chest properties.
switch: Change a switch Blueprint made by create_interactable: switchType (button or lever flip per press, pressure_plate holds while stood on; a new type rewrites the switch logic), canToggle and resetTime (Blueprint variables). Only the fields sent change, and the Blueprint is saved; one without the SwitchMesh component is refused.
trace: Configure persistent interaction trace data.

switchPath.description: Canonical /Game switch actor Blueprint asset path.

switchType.description: button (the default) or lever flip on each press; pressure_plate is on only while stood on.

traceDistance.description: Interaction trace distance in world units.

traceRadius.description: Cross-section of each box component in world units (default 50): a box gets extent traceDistance by traceRadius. Sphere components ignore it.

traceType.description: Free-text name stored in the TraceType Name variable of the Blueprint (default sphere). It does not choose or change a trace shape: the shape comes from the sphere and box components, which traceDistance and traceRadius resize.

triggerPath.description: Canonical /Game trigger actor Blueprint asset path.

triggerShape.description: Trigger volume shape (box, sphere, or capsule).

tools.name: manage_inventory
tools.description: Create item data assets, inventory components, world pickups, loot tables, and crafting recipes.

categoryPath.description: Item category asset, as create_inventory_asset kind=item_category makes it; one that names no asset is refused (ASSET_NOT_FOUND).

entryIndex.description: Number n of the LootEntry_<n> key of the entry to remove: the entryIndex add_loot_entry returned, or the n in a LootEntry_<n> key of get_inventory_info properties. It is a key suffix, not a position: removing an entry renumbers nothing, and a new entry takes one past the highest suffix in use.

iconPath.description: Texture or material asset used as the item icon; it must exist (ASSET_NOT_FOUND). An empty string clears the icon.

ingredientItemPath.description: Ingredient item asset; one that names no asset is refused (ASSET_NOT_FOUND).

kind.description:
Which create inventory asset variant to run.
item_data_asset: Create an item data asset.
item_category: Create an item category asset.
loot_table: Create a loot table asset.
crafting_recipe: Create a crafting recipe asset.
crafting_station: Create a crafting station Blueprint asset.

lootWeight.description: Chance of this entry relative to the others in the table, 0 or more (default 1).

maxQuantity.description: Most the entry grants, at least minQuantity (default minQuantity, or 1).

maxStackSize.description: Most items one stack holds, 1 or more. Only the stacking fields sent are written.

minQuantity.description: Fewest the entry grants, 0 or more (default 1).

name.description: Name for the created asset or actor.

outputItemPath.description: Item asset the recipe produces; one that names no asset is refused (ASSET_NOT_FOUND).

path.description: Canonical /Game output path for the created asset.

quantity.description: How many of the ingredient one craft consumes, 1 or more (default 1).

replicated.description: true: the inventory variables replicate under replicationCondition. false, the default when omitted: they stop replicating.

replicationCondition.description: When they replicate: an ELifetimeCondition name with or without COND_ (None, the default, OwnerOnly, SkipOwner, SimulatedOnly, InitialOnly ...). Ignored when replicated is false; an unknown name is refused.

requiredLevel.description: Minimum character level to craft, 0 or more. Only the requirement fields sent are written.

requiredStation.description: Crafting station the recipe needs, stored as given (a station type such as Forge). Only the requirement fields sent are written.

save.description: Save the asset to disk after the change (default true, for every inventory action). With false the change stays in memory only and is lost when the editor restarts.

setting.description:
Which configure crafting variant to run.
add_recipe_ingredient: Add an ingredient to a crafting recipe asset.
recipe_requirements: Configure persistent crafting requirements.

stackable.description: Whether the item stacks. Only the stacking fields sent are written.

name.description: Quality tier name.

dropWeight.description: Relative drop weight for the tier.

tiers.description: Quality tiers, each {name, dropWeight}: a name without commas or equals signs and a weight of 0 or more. A malformed entry or an empty list is refused; omitted, the five defaults are written (Common 60, Uncommon 25, Rare 10, Epic 4, Legendary 1). Replaces the tiers already there.

uniqueItems.description: Whether duplicate instances of the item are disallowed (bUniqueItem). Only the stacking fields sent are written.

tools.name: manage_level
tools.description: Load/save levels, configure streaming, and build lighting.

color.description: Light color [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a]. Linear 0-1 channels, stored by the engine as the 8-bit sRGB color: {r: 1, g: 0.7, b: 0.42} reads back as (255, 218, 173). A missing channel reads 0 (alpha 1). properties.color wins over it.

discardUnsaved.description: Load even though open levels have unsaved changes, dropping them. Without this or saveDirtyPackages, a load that would drop unsaved level changes is refused with DIRTY_PACKAGES, which lists them (the editor loaded over them without a word).

enableWorldBoundsChecks.description: Whether actors leaving the world bounds are culled.

gameMode.description: GameMode override for the level. Accepts the Blueprint asset path or its generated _C class path.

gravityZ.description: World gravity along Z; setting it also enables the global gravity override.

info.description:
Which get summary variant to run; omit for 'summary'.
summary: Return a summary of a level asset (native maps to get_level_info).
current_level: Return the path of the level currently loaded in the editor.

intensity.description: Brightness: the light component's Intensity, set as given, in the component's own units (a directional light is in lux). Left out, the engine default stays. properties.intensity wins over it.

killZ.description: Z height below which actors are destroyed.

levelName.description: Alias of levelPath, read first when both are given.

levelOp.description:
Which duplicate level variant to run; omit for 'duplicate'.
duplicate: Duplicate a level asset to a new destination path.
rename: Rename a level asset, keeping it in the same parent directory.

levelPath.description: Alias of subLevelPath, read when subLevelPath is absent.

lightClass.description: Light class name or path, for a class lightType does not name, including a Blueprint light (/Game/Lights/BP_Lamp.BP_Lamp_C); build_environment list_light_types lists the loaded ones. Wins over lightType.

lightType.description: Light kind: point, spot, directional, rect or sky (any case), or the class name PointLight, SpotLight, DirectionalLight, RectLight or SkyLight. A light class of your own goes in lightClass.

location.description: World location {x, y, z}; 0, 0, 300 when omitted.

name.description: Light actor name.

newName.description: New name for the level asset.

overwrite.description: Overwrite if the destination already exists.

parentLevel.description: Level the sub-level belongs to; it must be the level open in the editor, or the call is refused (load it first).

properties.description: Light component settings, applied to the lights they fit; the reply lists what went in as details.applied, what did not as details.refused ("name: why") and any value replaced for being out of range as details.adjusted. Keys: intensity (0 or more; a negative reads 0), color (as above), castShadows (true or false), useAsAtmosphereSunLight (true or false; a directional light given properties is the atmosphere sun unless this says false), attenuationRadius (above 0, point and spot lights; an invalid value reads 1000), innerConeAngle and outerConeAngle (0 to 180 degrees, spot lights; clamped), sourceWidth and sourceHeight (above 0, rect lights; an invalid value reads 100). A sky light takes only the top-level intensity and color. Any other key, or one that does not fit the light, is refused by name.

quality.description: Lighting build quality: Preview, Medium, High, or Production.

rotation.description: Actor rotation {pitch, yaw, roll} or {x, y, z, w}. A spot or directional light shines along its forward axis, so pitch -90 points it straight down.

saveDirtyPackages.description: Save every dirty level and asset package first, in every mode (an interactive editor used to ignore it); the load fails DIRTY_PACKAGES when one cannot be saved, and a headless run refuses to load over dirty packages unless this is true. Done even when the level is already open and nothing is loaded.

saveMode.description:
Which save variant to run; omit for 'save'.
save: Save the current level, optionally to a target path.
as: Save the current level to a new path.

shouldBeLoaded.description: Load it (true, the default) or stream it out (false). In the editor false hides it instead, with a warning; a sublevel added AlwaysLoaded stays loaded in the game and is hidden.

shouldBeVisible.description: Draw it (true, the default) or keep it loaded but hidden (false); ignored when shouldBeLoaded is false.

streamOp.description:
Which stream variant to run; omit for 'stream'.
stream: Stream a sublevel of the open level in or out: during Play in the running game (settled before the reply), otherwise shown or hidden in the editor, which keeps every sublevel loaded.
unload: Stream a sublevel of the open level out: during Play it unloads in the running game; in the editor, which keeps every sublevel loaded, it is hidden instead and the reply warns.

streaming.description: Stream the level into the open level as a sub-level (like add_sublevel) instead of replacing it.

streamingMethod.description: Blueprint (default): the game streams it in and out, and it starts unloaded. AlwaysLoaded: loaded whenever the open level is.

subLevelPath.description: The level map to add, by /Game package path (an object path or .umap name is cut to the package); it must exist.

timeDilation.description: Global time dilation multiplier for the level.

useWorldPartition.description: Create the level with World Partition enabled.

tools.name: manage_level_structure
tools.description: Structure worlds: levels, sublevels, World Partition, streaming, data layers, HLOD, level instances, trigger/blocking/physics/audio/post-process volumes, and nav bounds.

bEnabled.description: Whether the audio volume is enabled.

bIsPrivate.description: Make the data layer private to this world (UE 5.3 or later).

bShouldBeVisible.description: Level should be visible when loaded.

bShouldBlockOnLoad.description: Block game until level is loaded.

bUnbound.description: Whether post process volume affects entire world.

bUseExternalActors.description: Also move the level actors into one-file-per-actor packages (default false).

bWaterVolume.description: Whether this is a water volume.

blendRadius.description: Blend radius for post process volume.

blueprintPath.description: Packed Level Blueprint to create or update (default <level folder>/BPP_<LevelName>).

bounds.description: Volume bounds as a six-number array [minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ].

createVolume.description: Create a streaming volume (true) or report existing volumes (false).

cullDistances.description: Size/distance pairs for cull distance volumes.

damagePerSec.description: Damage per second for pain volumes.

dataLayerType.description: Runtime (default: loaded and unloaded in the game) or Editor (editor-only organisation).

edit.description:
Which edit level blueprint variant to run.
open: Open the Level Blueprint editor of the open level (levelPath picks a loaded sublevel; default the persistent level), creating the Level Blueprint when the level has none yet. A level never saved (/Temp) has none to open, and an editor that does not open is EDITOR_NOT_OPENED; a headless editor only checks the Blueprint is there (headlessSafeMode). Nothing is changed or saved.
add_node: Add a node to the level blueprint graph, including an event bound to a placed actor (OnActorBeginOverlap of a trigger), a reference to one, or a getter of its component; the reply lists the node's pins.
connect_nodes: Link sourceNodeName.sourcePinName to targetNodeName.targetPinName in the level Blueprint through the graph schema: incompatible types or directions are refused with the schema's reason (CONNECTION_REFUSED), a cast gets its conversion node, and a pin that takes one link drops its old one. A pin a node lacks is PIN_NOT_FOUND, naming the pins on both nodes. The level stays unsaved unless save is true (saved).
remove_node: Remove a level blueprint node by id, name or title (one several nodes share is refused), or purge unbound call nodes.
set_pin_default_value: Set the default value of an input pin on a level blueprint node (in its event graph or one of its functions), such as the color SetLightColor sets; a read-only (const reference) pin gets it through a MakeLiteral node wired into it.

eventName.description: Event dispatcher of actorName that a K2Node_ActorBoundEvent binds, e.g. OnActorBeginOverlap or OnActorEndOverlap; a wrong name is refused with the actor's events listed. Refused for any other node: BeginPlay or Tick go in nodeClass (EventBeginPlay, EventTick).

extent.description: Extent (half-size) of the volume in each axis.

filter.description: Only volumes whose label contains this text, ignoring case (e.g. "Kill", "Water"). For a kind of volume use volumeType.

functionName.description: Function to bind when nodeClass is K2Node_CallFunction (e.g. PrintString); short function names may also be passed as nodeClass.

gridName.description: World Partition runtime hash set grid name.

killZHeight.description: World Z of the kill plane (KillZVolume); sets the volume height.

kind.description:
Which create level structure variant to run.
level: Create an empty level asset, levelName in levelPath (default /Game/Maps), saved unless save is false. bCreateWorldPartition makes it a World Partition level (external actors then default on; bUseExternalActors false keeps them in the level). A level already at that path is reported (alreadyExisted), never replaced. loadAfterCreate opens it, refused with DIRTY_PACKAGES (naming them) when open levels have unsaved changes the load would drop.
sublevel: Create an empty level asset (sublevelName, in sublevelPath, else beside the open level, or /Game/Maps when the open level was never saved) and stream it into the open level by streamingMethod (Blueprint, the default, or AlwaysLoaded). parentLevel, when given, must be the open level (PARENT_LEVEL_NOT_LOADED otherwise, nothing created). A level already at that path is reported (alreadyExisted, streamingAdded), not replaced; manage_level add_sublevel streams it. save (default true) saves the new level and the open level.
level_instance: Place a Level Instance actor that loads an existing level asset at a location, so one saved level (a room, a building) can be reused inside another.
packed_level_actor: Bake the static meshes of a level into a Packed Level Blueprint (instanced static mesh components) and optionally place it (UE 5.3 or later).
data_layer: Create a World Partition data layer: a DataLayerAsset named dataLayerName in dataLayerAssetPath (default /Game/DataLayers), saved, and its instance in the open level, Runtime (streams in the game, the default) or Editor (organises the editor only), visible and loaded in the editor by default. Needs World Partition with external actors (WORLD_PARTITION_NOT_ENABLED, EXTERNAL_ACTORS_NOT_ENABLED); an unknown dataLayerType is refused before anything is created. Add actors with assign_actor_to_data_layer.
minimap_volume: Place a World Partition minimap volume, the area the minimap builder captures: a box brush of extent (half size, default 10000 on each axis) at location, labelled volumeName (default MinimapVolume). A level without World Partition is refused (WORLD_PARTITION_NOT_ENABLED); UE 5.1 or later. The level stays unsaved unless save is true.

label.description: Actor label of the new instance (default LI_<LevelName>).

layerType.description: HLOD layer type: Instancing, MeshMerge (default), MeshSimplify or MeshApproximate (SimplifiedMesh and ApproximatedMesh are accepted for the last two); another is refused.

levelAssetPath.description: Saved level asset to instance or pack, e.g. /Game/Maps/Room01 (not the open level).

loadAfterCreate.description: Open the new level in the editor after creating it (default false). When open levels have unsaved changes the load would drop, the call is refused with DIRTY_PACKAGES (listing them in unsavedPackages) before anything is created.

oneOf.description: World location {x, y, z}.
World location {x, y, z}; the world origin when omitted.

memberClass.description: Class that declares functionName when it is not in the common Blueprint libraries, or memberName: a native class name or a Blueprint asset path. The node's Target (self pin) takes an object of that class, so an actor's function or component getter is fed from its K2Node_Literal, while a component's function (a light's SetLightColor is LightComponent's) takes the component that getter returns, not the actor. One that names no class is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

memberName.description: Variable a K2Node_VariableGet or K2Node_VariableSet reads or writes, required by both and refused for other nodes: a level Blueprint variable (its own or inherited, such as Tags), or with memberClass a property of that class, such as a placed actor's component (PointLightComponent on PointLight, StaticMeshComponent on StaticMeshActor); with memberClass the node always has the self pin the actor's K2Node_Literal feeds, even for Actor. A wrong name is refused with that class's components listed (VARIABLE_NOT_FOUND), and one Blueprints cannot read, or for a VariableSet write (not Blueprint-visible, read-only), with VARIABLE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE.

nodeId.description: The node: the nodeId or nodeName add_level_blueprint_node returned, or its title, matched exactly (a node that only contains it is not taken). A name or title several nodes share is refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS_NODE).

parentLevel.description: The level to stream it into; must be the level open in the editor (omit for the open level).

pinName.description: Input pin name or display name, as add_level_blueprint_node lists them (NewLightColor on SetLightColor).

postProcessSettings.description: PostProcessVolume overrides: bloomEnabled, exposureBias, vignetteIntensity, saturation, contrast, gamma.

propertyValue.description: The pin's new default: a number, true or false, text, an enum value name, an asset path, a vector as X,Y,Z or {x,y,z}, a rotator as P,Y,R or {pitch,yaw,roll}, a color as {r,g,b,a}.

save.description: Save the level after the edit (default false, because saving also writes every other unsaved change in that level); the reply says saved: false while it is only in memory.

setting.description:
Which configure level streaming variant to run; omit for 'streaming'.
streaming: Change how the open level streams a sublevel (levelName: its package path or short name): streamingMethod Blueprint or AlwaysLoaded (switched as the Levels panel does), bShouldBeVisible, bShouldBlockOnLoad and bDisableDistanceStreaming; only the fields sent change. A level on disk that the open level does not stream yet is added to it first; one that does not exist is LEVEL_NOT_FOUND. The open level stays unsaved unless save is true.
streaming_distance: Stream a sublevel by where the player is: place a Level Streaming Volume, a box reaching streamingDistance (default 10000) from volumeLocation (default the origin) on each axis, bound to the sublevel (levelName) so it loads while a viewer is inside it. streamingUsage picks what it controls (LoadingAndVisibility, the default, Loading, VisibilityBlockingOnLoad, BlockingOnLoad, LoadingNotVisible); an unknown one or a distance of 0 or less is refused before anything is placed. createVolume false only lists the volumes bound to the level. A level on disk the open level does not stream yet is added first. The open level stays unsaved unless save is true.
world_partition: Turn World Partition on for the open level in place: it creates the World Partition object on the level's World Settings (save and reload the level before streaming works); bUseExternalActors also moves every actor into its own package (one file per actor), which data layers need. Turning it off on a partitioned level is refused (NOT_SUPPORTED), as is a level that cannot take it. The level stays unsaved unless save is true.
grid_size: Set a World Partition streaming grid of the open level (gridName; omitted, the first grid, or MainPartition on a Runtime Hash Set level): gridCellSize, loadingRange (how far from the player its cells load), bBlockOnSlowStreaming and priority; only the fields sent change, and a grid missing by name is added with createIfMissing (default true), the others at their defaults (cell 12800, range 25600). On a Runtime Hash Set level the grid is a runtime partition row, which must have a Main Layer to hold the values (PARTITION_HAS_NO_LAYER otherwise). The reply gives the edited grid values as they now stand (on a Runtime Hash Set level, the values it set) and lists every grid; a grid found with nothing sent to change is refused. The level stays unsaved unless save is true.
hlod_layer: Create an HLOD layer asset (hlodLayerName, in hlodLayerPath, default /Game/HLOD): layerType Instancing, MeshMerge (default), MeshSimplify or MeshApproximate, spatially loaded (default true) with its cellSize (default 25600) and loadingDistance (default 51200). An unknown layerType is refused before anything is created; each value reports whether it took (layerTypeApplied and the others). Saved unless save is false.
data_layer_assignment: Add a placed actor (actorName: label or name, or actorPath) to a data layer of the open level (dataLayerName: its short or full name), so it loads and shows with that layer. One already in the layer is reported (alreadyAssigned); a layer that is not there is refused with the ones that are. Needs World Partition with external actors; the level stays unsaved unless save is true.

sourceNodeName.description: Source node: the nodeName or nodeId add_level_blueprint_node returned, or its title. An exact match wins; otherwise the last node whose name or title contains it.

spawn.description: Place the Blueprint in the open level (default true).

streamingDistance.description: How far the volume reaches from its centre on each axis, in world units, over 0 (default 10000).

streamingMethod.description: Level streaming method: Blueprint (loaded on demand) or AlwaysLoaded.

streamingUsage.description: What the volume controls (default LoadingAndVisibility: load and show the level while a viewer is inside).

sublevelPath.description: Folder for the new level, or its full package path ending in sublevelName (default: the open level's folder).

targetNodeName.description: Target node: the nodeName or nodeId add_level_blueprint_node returned, or its title. An exact match wins; otherwise the last node whose name or title contains it.

unboundOnly.description: Remove every call-function node that has no bound function instead of a named node.

volumeClass.description: Volume class to spawn. Each class takes only its own parameters; one it would ignore is refused.

oneOf.description: Location of the volume.
World location of the volume's centre {x, y, z} (default the origin).

volumeProperty.description:
Which set volume properties variant to run; omit for 'properties'.
properties: Set generic properties (enabled, blend, priority) on an existing volume.
extent: Set the extent (half-size) of an existing volume.
bounds: Set the bounds (min/max) of an existing volume.

volumeType.description: Only volumes whose class name contains this, ignoring case (e.g. "PostProcess", "Physics", "Blocking"); "Trigger" also returns the trigger actors (TriggerBox, TriggerSphere).

tools.name: manage_networking
tools.description: Configure multiplayer and player flow: replication, RPCs, authority/relevancy, network prediction, sessions, split-screen, LAN/voice chat, game framework classes, match rules, and input mappings.

actionName.description: Legacy input action name. Overrides name when both are supplied.

actorName.description: Target actor label or name in the current level.

alt.description: Whether the Alt modifier must be held.

axisName.description: Legacy input axis name. Overrides name when both are supplied.

bDelayedStart.description: Hold the match in WaitingToStart until StartMatch is called (AGameMode::bDelayedStart).

check.description:
Which check authority variant to run.
has_authority: Read runtime actor authority state.
is_locally_controlled: Read local-control state for an actor.

cmd.description: Whether the Cmd modifier must be held.

condition.description: Replication condition, a ELifetimeCondition name such as COND_OwnerOnly, COND_SkipOwner, COND_InitialOnly or COND_AutonomousOnly; an unknown name is refused.

ctrl.description: Whether the Ctrl modifier must be held.

dataType.description: Variable type in the add_variable grammar: Vector, Rotator, Transform, Float, Int, Bool, Name, Struct:/Game/Path/S_Name.S_Name, Array:Vector and so on.

dormancy.description: Net dormancy, a ENetDormancy name: DORM_Never, DORM_Awake, DORM_DormantAll, DORM_DormantPartial or DORM_Initial; an unknown name is refused.

enablePrediction.description: CharacterMovement bNetworkAlwaysReplicateTransformUpdateTimestamp: always replicate the transform timestamp simulated proxies smooth with.

functionName.description: The RPC. For setting=create, a new name that no function, variable, event or other member of the Blueprint or its parent class holds (NAME_TAKEN). For validation and reliability, an existing RPC: a function create made, or a custom event set to replicate in the editor (NOT_FOUND, or NOT_AN_RPC for one that does not replicate).

inputs.description: RPC parameters, each {name, type}, with the types add_function inputs take (Float, Vector, Actor, Array<Int> ...), sent with every call. A nameless entry or a type no pin takes is refused (TYPE_RESOLUTION_FAILED) before anything changes. Default none.

interfaceType.description: Online subsystem name: Null (LAN and local play), Steam, EOS, ... Its OnlineSubsystem<Name> plugin must be enabled; LAN (use Null) and Utils (a helper module) are refused.

isAutonomousProxy.description: true: every replicated variable replicates to the autonomous proxy only (COND_AutonomousOnly). false: variables using COND_AutonomousOnly go back to COND_None; other conditions stay.

key.description: Input key name, e.g. SpaceBar, W, LeftMouseButton.

kind.description:
Which create framework class variant to run.
game_mode: Create a GameMode Blueprint (name, in path) whose parent is GameModeBase or the parentClass given (a child of GameModeBase; an unloadable one, or one that is not, is refused). An asset already at the path is refused (CREATION_FAILED). defaultPawnClass, playerControllerClass, gameStateClass, playerStateClass and hudClass set its classes; each must load and be the kind its slot holds (a Pawn for the pawn), checked before anything is created. Saved unless save is false (saved); the reply gives assetPath.
game_state: Create a GameState Blueprint (name, in path) whose parent is GameStateBase or the parentClass given (a child of GameStateBase; an unloadable one, or one that is not, is refused). An asset already at the path is refused (CREATION_FAILED). Saved unless save is false (saved); the reply gives assetPath.
game_instance: Create a GameInstance Blueprint (name, in path) whose parent is GameInstance or the parentClass given (a child of GameInstance; an unloadable one, or one that is not, is refused). An asset already at the path is refused (CREATION_FAILED). Saved unless save is false (saved); the reply gives assetPath.
player_controller: Create a PlayerController Blueprint (name, in path) whose parent is PlayerController or the parentClass given (a child of PlayerController; an unloadable one, or one that is not, is refused). An asset already at the path is refused (CREATION_FAILED). Saved unless save is false (saved); the reply gives assetPath.
player_state: Create a PlayerState Blueprint (name, in path) whose parent is PlayerState or the parentClass given (a child of PlayerState; an unloadable one, or one that is not, is refused). An asset already at the path is refused (CREATION_FAILED). Saved unless save is false (saved); the reply gives assetPath.
hud: Create a HUD Blueprint (name, in path) whose parent is HUD or the parentClass given (a child of HUD; an unloadable one, or one that is not, is refused). An asset already at the path is refused (CREATION_FAILED). Saved unless save is false (saved); the reply gives assetPath.

makeDefault.description: Also make this game mode the project default game mode (DefaultEngine.ini); default false changes only the class on this game mode.

mapping.description:
Which add legacy mapping variant to run.
action: Add a legacy action mapping.
axis: Add a legacy axis mapping.

maxClientRate.description: Game net driver MaxClientRate (bytes per second per LAN client).

maxInternetClientRate.description: Game net driver MaxInternetClientRate (bytes per second per internet client).

micInputGain.description: Microphone input gain as a linear multiplier, 0 to 10 (console variable voice.MicInputGain, default 1).

name.description: Name of the asset, actor or mapping to create, or of the mapping to remove.

netLoadOnClient.description: Load the placed actor on clients with the map (AActor bNetLoadOnClient).

netServerMaxTickRate.description: Game net driver NetServerMaxTickRate (server ticks per second).

networkMaxSmoothUpdateDistance.description: CharacterMovement NetworkMaxSmoothUpdateDistance in cm: corrections farther than this snap after smoothing.

networkNoSmoothUpdateDistance.description: CharacterMovement NetworkNoSmoothUpdateDistance in cm: corrections farther than this snap without smoothing.

networkSmoothingMode.description: CharacterMovement NetworkSmoothingMode: Disabled, Linear, Exponential or Replay.

noiseGateThreshold.description: Noise gate threshold in linear amplitude, 0 to 1: quieter input is sent as silence (voice.MicNoiseGateThreshold).

parentClass.description: Parent class path or short name.

path.description: Canonical /Game folder for the created asset.

pawnClass.description: The default pawn class (a class path or Blueprint path); required, or send it as defaultPawnClass.

playerStartName.description: Label or name of the PlayerStart in the open level; optional only when the level has exactly one.

playerStartTag.description: Tag to set on the PlayerStart (PlayerStartTag); give it or teamIndex.

reliable.description: Reliable: resent until it arrives, in order. Unreliable calls can be dropped under load, which suits frequent cosmetic updates. Creating defaults to true.

repNotifyFunc.description: Function clients call when the variable's new value arrives; the variable also becomes replicated. It must take no parameters and return nothing: the Blueprint's own or an inherited one is used, a missing one is created empty (functionCreated), one with parameters or a return value is refused (the compiler drops it), and a name another member holds is NAME_TAKEN.

replaceKey.description: A key the action is already mapped to: its mapping moves to key (the remap of a control), keeping its triggers and modifiers unless triggerType or modifierType is sent, and that key stops firing the action. A key the action is not mapped to fails NOT_FOUND and lists the keys it is.

role.description: How clients see the actor: ROLE_None (not replicated), ROLE_SimulatedProxy or ROLE_AutonomousProxy (replicated). ROLE_Authority is refused: the server always has it.

rpcType.description: Where the call runs: Server (called on a client, on an actor its player owns, and run on the server), Client (called on the server, run on the owning player client) or NetMulticast (called on the server, run there and on every client). Multicast is accepted too, in any case; anything else is refused.

sampleRate.description: VoIP sample rate in Hz, 16000 or 24000 (Audio settings VoiPSampleRate).

save.description: Save the Blueprint asset to disk after the change (default true).

serverAddress.description: Host name or IP of the server to join, such as 127.0.0.1 (no port, which goes in serverPort).

serverOp.description:
Which host lan server variant to run; omit for 'host'.
host: Build the LAN listen-server travel URL for a map; nothing is hosted unless executeTravel is true, which travels the running world to it.
join: Make a running Play-In-Editor instance join a server at serverAddress:serverPort (ClientTravel); the connection completes asynchronously. Refused when PIE is not running or every instance is hosting.

serverPort.description: Game port, a whole number (engine default 7777). configure_lan_play takes 1024 to 65535; a join without it uses the project default port.

setting.description:
Which configure game mode variant to run.
default_pawn_class: Set a GameMode default pawn class. Pass makeDefault: true to also make this game mode the project default; the reply says whether the open level runs it (effectiveInOpenLevel).
player_controller_class: Set a GameMode PlayerController class. Pass makeDefault: true to also make this game mode the project default; the reply says whether the open level runs it (effectiveInOpenLevel).
game_state_class: Set a GameMode GameState class. Pass makeDefault: true to also make this game mode the project default; the reply says whether the open level runs it (effectiveInOpenLevel).
player_state_class: Set a GameMode PlayerState class. Pass makeDefault: true to also make this game mode the project default; the reply says whether the open level runs it (effectiveInOpenLevel).
hud_class: Set a GameMode HUD class. Pass makeDefault: true to also make this game mode the project default; the reply says whether the open level runs it (effectiveInOpenLevel).
rules: Set a GameMode's bDelayedStart match rule; only GameMode (AGameMode) children have it, a GameModeBase child is refused with NOT_SUPPORTED.
respawn: Set the game mode's minimum respawn delay (AGameMode::MinRespawnDelay); a GameModeBase child is refused with NOT_SUPPORTED.
spectating: Set the GameMode spectator pawn class (SpectatorClass).

shift.description: Whether the Shift modifier must be held.

silenceDetectionThreshold.description: Silence detection threshold in linear amplitude, 0 to 1: below it no voice packet is sent (voice.SilenceDetectionThreshold).

smoothingRate.description: Seconds simulated proxies take to smooth a server correction (location and rotation, dedicated and listen server).

spatiallyLoaded.description: World Partition: stream the actor in by distance (AActor bIsSpatiallyLoaded).

spectatorClass.description: SpectatorPawn class path, e.g. /Script/Engine.SpectatorPawn or a Blueprint path.

splitScreenType.description: Split-screen layout name: None (off), TwoPlayer_Horizontal, TwoPlayer_Vertical, ThreePlayer_FavorTop, ThreePlayer_FavorBottom, ThreePlayer_Vertical, ThreePlayer_Horizontal, FourPlayer_Grid, FourPlayer_Vertical or FourPlayer_Horizontal.

teamIndex.description: 1-based team number; sets the PlayerStart tag TeamN (the engine picks no start by team; a game mode must read the tag). Give it or playerStartTag.

travelOptions.description: Extra URL options appended to the travel URL, such as Name=Player1 or ?Team=2.

variableName.description: Variable to add or convert; default PredictionData_<dataType> (required when dataType is not a plain type name).

voiceEnabled.description: Whether voice chat is on. enable starts or stops the voice chat service now; settings writes the startup switches [Voice] bEnabled and [OnlineSubsystem] bHasVoiceEnabled.

withValidation.description: true is refused (NOT_SUPPORTED): only C++ RPCs have a validation step, so check the parameters at the start of the RPC body instead. false clears a validation flag an earlier call stored (changed says whether one was there).

tools.name: manage_pcg
tools.description: Create, edit, execute, and configure PCG graphs: graph assets, input/sampler/filter/spawner nodes, pin connections, node settings, and partition grid size.

createComponent.description: Create a new PCG component when no selector is supplied.

edit.description:
Which edit pcg graph variant to run.
create: Create a PCG graph asset at graphPath (or assetPath, or name in path, default /Game/PCG), saved unless save is false. A PCG graph already at the path is refused (ASSET_ALREADY_EXISTS) unless overwrite is true, which returns that graph unchanged (created false); another kind of asset there is refused. The reply gives graphPath, name, created and saved. Needs the PCG plugin.
create_subgraph: Create a PCG graph at subgraphPath to run inside other graphs (the same rules as edit=create: one already there is refused unless overwrite is true, which reuses it), and with parentGraphPath add a Subgraph node running it to that graph, titled nodeName and placed at x, y. The reply gives subgraphPath, created and saved, and with a parent also parentGraphPath, nodeId (the new node, for edit=connect_pins) and parentSaved. A parent that does not load is ASSET_NOT_FOUND. Saved unless save is false.
connect_pins: Wire sourcePin (or outputName) of sourceNodeId to targetPin (or inputName) of targetNodeId in a PCG graph (graphPath or assetPath). A node is found by its nodeId (object name), its title, its index in the graph, or input and output for the graph's own ends (NODE_NOT_FOUND). A pin left out is the node's Out or In pin, else its first; a label it lacks is PIN_NOT_FOUND listing the labels. An edge already there is kept, not doubled. The reply gives both node ids, both pin labels and saved; saved unless save is false.
set_node_settings: Change a node of a PCG graph, found by nodeId or nodeName (an object name, title, index, or input and output; NODE_NOT_FOUND): settings sets properties by name (INVALID_SETTINGS for one it lacks), texturePath, meshPath and actorClass set the texture, mesh or spawned class of nodes that take them (each checked to load), title renames it and x, y move it. An edit that changes nothing, or sends only a meshPath or class the node has no slot for, is refused. The reply gives nodeId, title, nodeType, settingsApplied and saved; saved unless save is false.
set_partition_grid_size: Set the size of the cells partitioned PCG generates in (gridSize, a whole number of world units above 0): scope world (the default) sets the PCG world actor's partition grid, scope component one PCG component's generation grid (actorName, componentName or componentPath; COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND). The reply gives previousGridSize and gridSize. Saved with the level unless save is false, which saves every unsaved change in that level too.

force.description: Force regeneration even if a result already exists.

name.description: Name for the new asset or node.

nodeId.description: The node to change; required, or send it as nodeName.

nodeKind.description:
Which add pcg node variant to run; omit for 'node'.
node: Add a node to a PCG graph by settings class or alias.
surface_sampler: Add a Surface sampler node to a PCG graph.
spline_sampler: Add a Spline sampler node to a PCG graph.
mesh_sampler: Add a Mesh sampler node to a PCG graph.
volume_sampler: Add a Volume sampler node to a PCG graph.
static_mesh_spawner: Add a Static Mesh spawner node to a PCG graph.
actor_spawner: Add an Actor spawner node to a PCG graph.
spline_spawner: Add a Spline spawner node to a PCG graph.
density_filter: Add a Density filter node to a PCG graph.
distance_filter: Add a Distance filter node to a PCG graph.
height_filter: Add a Height filter node to a PCG graph.
slope_filter: Add a Slope filter node to a PCG graph.
bounds_filter: Add a Bounds filter node to a PCG graph.
bounds_modifier: Add a Bounds modifier node to a PCG graph.
landscape_data_node: Add a Landscape data source node to a PCG graph.
spline_data_node: Add a Spline data source node to a PCG graph.
actor_data_node: Add an Actor data source node to a PCG graph.
texture_data_node: Add a Texture data source node to a PCG graph.
volume_data_node: Add a Volume data source node to a PCG graph.
transform_points: Add a Transform Points node to a PCG graph.
copy_points: Add a Copy Points node to a PCG graph.
merge_points: Add a Merge Points node to a PCG graph.
project_to_surface: Add a Project to Surface node to a PCG graph.
self_pruning: Add a Self-pruning node to a PCG graph.

nodeType.description: PCG node type alias or UPCGSettings class path/name.

overwrite.description: Overwrite the asset when it already exists.

parentGraphPath.description: Parent PCG graph asset path for subgraph insertion.

save.description: Save the PCG graph asset after the edit (default true).

settings.description: UPCGSettings property key-value pairs applied by reflection.

settingsClass.description: UPCGSettings class path/name for the PCG node.

sourceNodeId.description: Source node identifier for pin connection.

subgraphPath.description: PCG subgraph asset path used by subgraph nodes.

targetNodeId.description: Target node identifier for pin connection.

x.description: Node graph X position (alias of posX).

y.description: Node graph Y position (alias of posY).

tools.name: manage_sequence
tools.description: Edit Level Sequences, cinematic tracks, Movie Render Queue jobs, media playback assets, Take Recorder, and replay controls.

activate.description: Whether the key activates (true) or deactivates (false).

actorName.description: Actor name in the current level.

actors.description: Actor names to record (alias of actorNames).

allJobs.description: Remove every job in the queue instead of one.

animationPath.description: Animation sequence asset path (alias of animationSequencePath).

antiAliasingMethod.description: Anti-aliasing method name, such as TSAA or FXAA.

audioOutput.description: true also writes a .wav of everything the world played during the render (music, effects, gameplay sounds) beside the frames; false removes it. MRQ records audio only when the editor runs with -DeterministicAudio, and the reply warns when it does not.

autoClear.description: Whether the media texture clears when playback stops.

autoPlay.description: Whether the media player plays automatically on open.

bindingId.description: Binding GUID (get_properties bindings): only the tracks of that bound object; with trackName, only those of its tracks the name picks.

compositeOntoFinalImage.description: Whether to composite onto the final image.

camera.description: The camera actor to fly, by name; when no actor has this name a CineCameraActor is spawned with it as its label (default FlyCamera).

cameraName.description: Actor name in the current level.

cameras.description: The camera actors to cut between (2-12), by name; where the sequence moves one, it is judged where the sequence has it.

checkpointSaveMaxMSPerFrame.description: Max checkpoint save MS per frame (<=1000).

className.description: Unreal class path for the spawnable.

clearSources.description: Remove every existing source before adding the ones sent (default false); alone it empties the take.

clearanceCm.description: How far from geometry the camera stays, in cm (default 50): the straight lines between corners keep all of it, the smoothed curve at least 80% of it. A gap narrower than twice this cannot be flown through.

componentName.description: Component of the actor the track works on. skeletal_animation: the skeletal mesh that plays the clip (default the actor's root when that is a skeletal mesh; it gets its own binding under the actor, because Sequencer otherwise plays the clip on the first skeletal mesh it finds, which on a character built from several meshes copies another's pose and shows nothing). material_parameter: the component owning the material.

compositeOntoFinalImage.description: For the ui pass: draw the UI over the final image (default true); false writes it as its own ViewportUI layer.

control.description:
Which create render job variant to run; omit for 'create'.
create: Create a Movie Render Queue job for sequencePath on mapPath (default: the open level), named renderJobName, with a PNG image sequence output and a deferred render pass, plus any output settings sent (outputDirectory, fileNameFormat, resolution, frameRate, a frame range, settings.handleFrameCount and zeroPadFrameNumbers), all checked before the job is made. The job lives in this editor session queue, not on disk; render it with control start.
queue: Enable a render job in the MRQ queue without starting execution. Enqueue does NOT mean render completion.
start: Start MRQ render execution. Blocks until completion, fatal error, or timeout. Supports advisory cancellation. renderTimeoutMs (how long the render may run before it is cancelled) defaults to 300000 (5 minutes) and may be as long as the plugin's MaxMovieRenderTimeoutMs (one hour by default); the native transport waits that long plus the cancellation wait for the reply.
cancel: Stop the Movie Render Queue render that is running, as the queue window's Stop does: every job is cancelled, frames already written stay on disk, and the sequence gets back the state the render held it in.
remove: Remove a render job from the Movie Render Queue, or every job (allJobs). Rendered files stay on disk. The queue holds a limited number of jobs, and a finished job stays queued (an unrestricted start renders it again), so remove finished ones before creating more.

currentAperture.description: Aperture as an f-stop (read before aperture).

currentFocalLength.description: Focal length in millimetres (read before focalLength).

defaultSourcePath.description: Default media source asset path for a platform media source.

deleteScope.description:
Which delete variant to run; omit for 'sequence'.
sequence: Permanently delete a Level Sequence asset: refused with SEQUENCE_IN_USE, naming referencedBy, while a level or asset still uses it (a Level Sequence Actor playing it). Its editors close and the undo history may be cleared.
track: Remove one track from a Level Sequence with its sections and keys, in one undo step: the track trackName names (its name or display name, case ignored; a part of a name only when one track alone contains it), the camera cut track too. A name several tracks fit is refused with AMBIGUOUS_TRACK naming them. The sequence is left unsaved.
keyframe: Remove keyframes from the tracks trackName or bindingId picks: the keys on one frame or on several, or every key on them, of every key type, in one undo step. Naming neither track nor binding is refused (TRACK_REQUIRED); a filter that matches no track is TRACK_NOT_FOUND.

disableOthers.description: Turn off every recorded property not named (default false), so the take records only those.

dryRun.description: Find the edit and answer without writing it (default false).

duration.description: Seconds (above 0) to record after the countdown before the take stops by itself.

oneOf.description: Frames at the start of the section over which the clip blends in from the clip it overlaps (0 or omitted: it takes over at once).
Frames the section fades in over; 0 removes its ease in.

easeInFrames.description: Frames at the start of the section over which the clip blends in from the clip it overlaps (0 or omitted: it takes over at once).

oneOf.description: Frames at the end of the section over which the clip blends out into the clip that overlaps it.
Frames the section fades out over; 0 removes its ease out.

easeOutFrames.description: Frames at the end of the section over which the clip blends out into the clip that overlaps it.

edit.description:
Which edit sequence bindings variant to run.
add_actor: Bind a placed actor (actorName, its label) to a Level Sequence as a possessable, reusing the binding it already has; a missing actor fails with NO_ACTORS_BOUND. Answers results with the bindingGuid.
add_actors: Bind several placed actors (actorNames, their labels) to a Level Sequence as possessables, reusing bindings they already have; answers each in results (bindingGuid or error) with successful and failed, and fails with NO_ACTORS_BOUND only when none bound.
add_camera: Add a camera to a Level Sequence: by default a CameraActor placed at the world origin (actorName labels it, default SequenceCamera; move it with control_actor) and bound as a possessable; spawnable true adds a camera the sequence owns, which exists only while it plays. An asset that is not a Level Sequence is refused before anything is placed, and a camera that could not be bound is removed again (BIND_FAILED).
add_spawnable: Add a spawnable of className (a class path or name) to a Level Sequence: an actor the sequence creates while it plays and removes after. An unknown class is CLASS_NOT_FOUND; answers the className resolved and its bindingGuid.
remove_actors: Remove the bindings of the named actors (actorNames) from a Level Sequence, with their tracks; answers removedActors and removed, and fails with NO_ACTORS_REMOVED when none of them was bound.

enabled.description: Turn the matched recorded properties on (default true) or off.

oneOf.description: Playback range end frame (exclusive); used when durationFrames is absent.
Section end in display-rate frames; used when durationFrames is absent.
